result.description: A fiction-first tabletop roleplaying boxed set featuring a core rulebook, modular encounter cards, a fold-out referee screen, character folios, dice tokens, and a campaign journal. Designed for collaborative storytelling rather than digital play, the set emphasizes narrative improvisation, mapless exploration, and episodic scenario building. Includes a 240-page softcover guide, two decks of scenario cards, six custom polyhedral dice, and reusable dry-erase status boards.
result.title: Solstice Arcana 12-Piece Tabletop Roleplaying Set
result.title_description: Fantasy tabletop roleplaying boxed set with books, cards, dice, and campaign accessories
